notes.title: Our Debut Trailer for Over the Radio
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700679/5afb5c9f0b7333ce6b6d025f1bc80dc088a6fdc2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]📢Hello Community!

It’s been a week since we released the first trailer for [i]Over the Radio[/i].[/p][p]If you haven’t had the chance to watch it yet, the video highlights the core experience of the game—two players communicating as Pilot and Navigator—alongside the flight screen, the paper map, replay system, and stage and aircraft variations.
[/p][previewyoutube="cE7_PicARvU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This is just the beginning: more content and details will be revealed as we continue development toward the planned 2026 release. We’d love for you to follow our social channels and join the journey with us![/p]
